command_dir.ask: Sample Scheduler's command folder (its LIMS 'Command folder', default C:\LIMS_Commands on the scheduler PC, as a share)
command_dir.help: Sample Scheduler Configuration > LIMS: the folder it polls for XML commands. Share it (or its UNC path) to the machine serving this package, writable by the account that runs mhp.

result_dir.ask: Folder where Sample Scheduler's 'Review for LIMS' copies result reports (its 'Result folder')
result_dir.help: Configure the project's report (csv or txt) to be copied there; the job returns its rows.

project.ask: OpenLab project the analyses run in

instrument.ask: Instrument name as Sample Scheduler shows it

injection_source.ask: Injection source as Sample Scheduler names it for this instrument

methods_dir.ask: Shared folder holding the project's method files, for list_methods

processing_method.ask: Processing method used when a sample names none
